title: Releasing this 3D asset, rigging, and animation generator
author: Soft_Negotiation3487
selftext: Give it a try at [https://orcaengine.ai](https://orcaengine.ai) and let us know what you think. We are keeping the inference free until we are done with our alpha tests.

comments.body: Looks cools I am about to check it out

comments.author: lachiemx
comments.body:
Quite good. The viewport is a little dim - i couldn't see my model in any detail. The model looked great. The texturing was blurry and needs a bit of work. Rigging looked good but I was unable to generate any animations or download the rigged character. It just downloaded the textured model.

Overall though very impressive. Keep up the great work. My model was the aztec zombie one.
